title: B1 · L11 — Reported speech: questions
topic: Reported speech: yes/no and Wh- questions
description: Estilo indirecto para preguntas: uso de 'if/whether' para preguntas de sí/no, mantenimiento de la palabra Wh- y orden afirmativo (sin auxiliar do/does).

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que un camarero te preguntó al entrar en el café.
questions.question: Complete: Direct: 'Do you like coffee?' Reported: 'She asked me ___ coffee.'
questions.explanation: Preguntas yes/no reportadas: usa 'if' (o 'whether'). Además hay backshift: 'do you like' → 'liked'. NUNCA se conserva 'do' auxiliar en reportadas. Error típico del hispanohablante: 'if I like' sin backshift o mantener el orden interrogativo.
examples: He asked me if I wanted tea or coffee. → yes/no reportada con backshift
She asked me if I lived nearby. → orden afirmativo tras 'if'

questions.prompt: Reportas la pregunta que te hicieron en una entrevista.
questions.question: Choose: Direct: 'Where do you live?' Reported: 'He asked me ___.'
questions.explanation: Preguntas Wh- reportadas: se mantiene el Wh- y el orden es AFIRMATIVO (sujeto + verbo), sin 'do/does/did'. Backshift: 'live' → 'lived'. Errores: (A) mantiene la inversión; (C) 'did' redundante; (D) mezcla imposible if+where.
examples: She asked me where I worked. → Wh- + orden afirmativo
He asked me what I wanted for dinner. → misma estructura

questions.statement: In reported questions, the word order changes to affirmative (subject + verb).
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Regla crítica: las preguntas indirectas SIEMPRE llevan orden afirmativo, sin inversión y sin auxiliar 'do/does/did'. 'Where do you live?' → 'where I lived'. Este es EL error más frecuente en hispanohablantes al reportar preguntas.
examples: She asked where he was going that afternoon. → sin inversión
He asked what time it was, honestly. → afirmativo tras Wh-

questions.text: She asked me if I had ever been to Australia before.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción típica: 'if I'd ever been' en habla natural. 'Had ever been' se pronuncia rápido, casi 'hadever-been'. Pregunta yes/no reportada con 'if' + present perfect ('have you ever been') → past perfect ('had ever been').
examples: He asked me if I'd seen the film that was out. → yes/no con backshift
She asked me if I'd visited the museum before. → mismo patrón

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que tu amiga te preguntó por WhatsApp.
questions.question: Complete: Direct: 'Are you coming?' Reported: 'She asked me ___ coming.'
questions.explanation: Pregunta yes/no con 'be': 'are you coming?' → 'if I was coming'. Backshift de present continuous → past continuous. Error típico: mantener 'am' (no hay backshift) o usar 'that' en lugar de 'if' (that es para afirmaciones).
examples: He asked me if I was ready to go. → yes/no + be reportada
She asked me if I was working from home. → misma estructura

questions.prompt: Empareja cada regla con su aplicación en reported questions:
questions.explanation: Cuatro reglas clave para reportar preguntas: (1) if/whether para yes/no, (2) mantener el Wh-, (3) orden afirmativo sin inversión, (4) eliminar do/does/did. Añade backshift habitual del verbo principal.
examples: He asked if she was coming to the party. → yes/no con if
She asked where he lived, out of curiosity. → Wh- + afirmativo

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que preguntó tu compañero antes de ir al cine.
questions.question: Choose the correct reported form: 'What time does the film start?'
options: He asked what time does the film start.
He asked what time the film started.
He asked what time did the film start.
He asked if what time the film started.
questions.explanation: Wh- + orden afirmativo (film started, no 'does the film start'). Backshift: 'starts' → 'started'. Errores: (A) mantiene 'does' y la inversión; (C) mezcla did+afirmativo; (D) 'if' + Wh- es imposible en la misma oración.
examples: She asked what time the meeting started, so we wouldn't be late. → Wh- reportada
He asked when the shop opened on Sundays. → hora reportada

questions.target: She asked me where I'd bought my new phone, actually — she wanted the same one.
questions.explanation: Situación: cuentas una conversación reciente a otro amigo. Wh- reportada con backshift (past simple → past perfect). Contracción 'I'd' obligatoria. 'Actually' + comentario final añaden autenticidad conversacional. Muy útil para relatar chismes/conversaciones.
examples: He asked me where I'd learned Spanish, and I told him I lived abroad. → pregunta + respuesta
She asked me where I'd found that recipe, it was that good. → reporte + contexto

questions.statement: 'She asked me where do I live?' is a correct reported question.
questions.explanation: FALSO. Doble error: (1) mantiene la inversión 'do I' propia de preguntas directas; (2) usa presente cuando debería haber backshift. Lo correcto: 'She asked me where I lived.' Este es EL error TOP en hispanohablantes por calco del inglés directo.
examples: She asked me where I lived. → orden afirmativo + backshift
He asked me what I did for work. → Wh- reportada correcta

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que te pidió alguien en apuros.
questions.question: Complete: Direct: 'Can you help me?' Reported: 'He asked me ___ help him.'
questions.explanation: 'Can' retrocede a 'could' en backshift. Preguntas yes/no van con 'if'. Errores: (A) sin backshift + orden interrogativo; (B) sin backshift de can; (D) 'that' es para afirmaciones, no preguntas.
examples: She asked me if I could drive her to the airport. → petición reportada
He asked me if I could speak French for a client. → habilidad requerida

questions.text: He asked me whether I preferred tea or coffee for breakfast.
questions.explanation: Nota la pronunciación de 'whether' /ˈweðə/ — la 'wh' se pronuncia como /w/ simple y la 'th' es /ð/ suave. 'Whether' es intercambiable con 'if' pero se prefiere cuando hay opciones ('whether X or Y') o en registro formal.
examples: She asked me whether I wanted to stay or leave. → opción explícita
He asked me whether I was happy or not with the result. → duda binaria

questions.prompt: Identifica la única frase con reported question bien construida.
questions.question: Which sentence is correctly reported?
options: She asked me what am I doing.
She asked me what I was doing.
She asked me what did I do.
She asked me if what I was doing.
questions.explanation: Wh- + orden afirmativo, sin auxiliar. Backshift 'am doing' → 'was doing'. Errores: (A) mantiene inversión 'am I'; (C) usa 'did' + cambio de tiempo verbal; (D) mezcla 'if' + Wh-.
examples: She asked me what I was reading, curious as usual. → Wh- reportada
He asked me what I was thinking about, out of the blue. → misma estructura

questions.statement: 'Whether' is more formal than 'if' and is common in writing.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Ambas son válidas y equivalentes en la mayoría de casos, pero 'whether' es más FORMAL y frecuente en textos escritos, contratos, comunicaciones profesionales. En habla informal se prefiere 'if'. 'Whether' obligatorio antes de infinitivo: 'I don't know whether to go.'
examples: The company asked whether the client had signed the contract. → registro formal
The teacher asked whether the students had understood the lesson. → escrito neutro

questions.prompt: Reportas la escena de una amiga preocupada por ti.
questions.question: Complete: Direct: 'Why are you crying?' Reported: 'She asked me ___ crying.'
questions.explanation: 'Why' + orden afirmativo: 'why I was'. Backshift: 'are you crying' → 'was crying'. Errores: (A) mantiene inversión; (C) cambia el tiempo pero mantiene did (redundante); (D) 'if' pierde el sentido de 'why'.
examples: He asked me why I was leaving so early. → causa reportada
She asked me why I was so upset that day. → emoción reportada

questions.target: He asked me if I'd enjoyed the concert the night before, and honestly, it was amazing.
questions.explanation: Situación: reportas una conversación reciente sobre un evento pasado. Pregunta yes/no reportada con present perfect → past perfect backshifted. 'Last night' → 'the night before'. Contracción 'I'd' + respuesta emocional 'honestly, it was amazing' hacen la frase natural.
examples: She asked me if I'd liked the food at the restaurant. → gustos reportados
He asked me if I'd understood the lesson, which was thoughtful. → comprobación reportada
